name: H3 MLP sequence chunking
plain: Runs each H3 block's MLP over slices of the token sequence and joins the results, to cut peak activation memory. The MLP works token by token, so the docstring argues the result is the same as the unchunked call. It only chunks sequences long enough to matter.
math: If tokens s ≥ min_tokens and chunks>1: for each slice of ⌈s/chunks⌉ tokens, y[i] = fc2(swiglu(fc1(x[i]))), written into a preallocated output.

props.architectures: Modules named *mlp with fc1 and fc2; calls core linear_input_act with swiglu
